## Findings

| ID | Category | Severity | Location(s) | Summary | Recommendation |
|----|----------|----------|-------------|---------|----------------|
| C1 | Coverage | MEDIUM | spec.md SC-003; tasks.md T010; plan.md Risks row 2 | SC-003 says fleet data "updates again" after returning to *Central en vivo*. T010 only counts a new `/now` request. Polling runs in every section (R3), so a new request proves polling is alive but not that the fleet view re-renders the new snapshot. | Either have T010 serve a second fixture with a distinguishable value after return and assert it renders, or reword SC-003 to "a new refresh request is issued within one interval". |
| A1 | Ambiguity | MEDIUM | tasks.md T011; spec.md Edge Cases (stale while away), FR-008 | T011 says "header badge / DataStateBanner reflect the degraded state" when only `/now` fails. In the current code a `/now` failure changes only the badge (`· sin conexión` suffix via `stale`); the banner is driven by `/source-status` and does not change. The expected assertion is unclear. | State the exact observable in T011: badge text contains «sin conexión» while on *Alertas*; banner assertions only if `/source-status` is also overridden. |
| U1 | Underspecification | LOW | tasks.md T010–T012 | US2 tests are written after T009, so they will likely pass on first run. T012 is conditional ("if T010 or T011 fail"). The red step of test-first is nominal for US2. Tests still exist before merge, so Principle V is met. | Label T010/T011 as regression tests for US2 and note that T012 may be a no-op. |
| U2 | Underspecification | LOW | data-model.md "Derived values"; tasks.md T009 | `SECTIONS.find(s => s.id === activeSection).label` returns `SectionDef \| undefined` under `strict: true`; the plan forbids `any` but does not say how the undefined case is handled. | Specify a total lookup in T009 (for example, a fallback to the first entry) so `tsc --noEmit` passes without a non-null assertion. |
| A2 | Ambiguity | LOW | spec.md SC-003, FR-006 | "One normal refresh interval" / "usual interval" is not quantified in the spec. The plan says 5 s and the test waits 7 s. | Add "(5 s today)" to SC-003 or reference the polling interval of the existing hooks. |
| I1 | Inconsistency | LOW | plan.md header and Risks row 4; quickstart.md Prerequisites | plan.md and quickstart.md say branch `feature/US-10`; spec.md, the ticket and the checked-out branch are `feature/US-10-frontend-sidebar-sections`. tasks.md Notes already flags it. | Update plan.md and quickstart.md to the real branch name. |
| I2 | Inconsistency | LOW | plan.md Project Structure; tasks.md T002, T003 | plan.md lists Sidebar test changes as "S2–S5" and omits `tests/a11y/TextNotColor.test.tsx`; tasks.md covers S1–S6 and adds T003 for TextNotColor. | Align plan.md's file tree with tasks.md. |

Not a violation. | Cite the mitigating specs/PRs in the Principle I row for traceability. |
